name: ipfs
description: Publish your site to IPFS (Pinata or a local Kubo node)
author: moss team

config_descriptions.provider: Where to pin your site: "pinata" (hosted) or "local" (your own Kubo daemon).
config_descriptions.gateway: Optional gateway host for View-site links, e.g. gateway.pinata.cloud. Blank uses dweb.link.
config_descriptions.pin_name: Label for the pin in your provider. Defaults to your site name.
config_descriptions.use_ipns: Publish a stable IPNS name so your URL and DNSLink domain don't change every deploy.
config_descriptions.relative_urls: Rewrite absolute links in HTML to relative ones so the site renders on any IPFS gateway.
config_descriptions.node_rpc: Kubo RPC endpoint for the local provider. Blank uses this machine (127.0.0.1:5001); set it to publish through an always-on node (NAS, VPS).
config_descriptions.co_pin: After each deploy, also pin the same content to the other backend when it's available — same address, one more copy.
